newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise January rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise January rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday it would raise the margin requirement on its January rubber futures contract by 50,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The rise will bring the total January requirement to 127,750 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The increase is intended to cool overheated trade.
The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
